title: Fix deployment failure and redeploy Valentine page

requirements.text: Investigate the current hosted-environment build/deployment failure, fix the underlying issue (frontend build and/or canister deploy), and rerun the deployment so the latest Valentine page is successfully published.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean production build completes successfully without errors.
Deployment completes successfully in the hosted environment (no deployment failure).
The deployed site loads and functions as expected (Valentine prompt, evasive "No" button behavior, and the "She said yes" success state with the meme image).

requirements.text: Ensure the deployment output is reachable at the intended icp0.io subdomain and matches the configured domain value: https://Romanticproposal.icp0.io.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting https://Romanticproposal.icp0.io loads the app successfully.
The page shows the Valentine prompt UI and works on both desktop and iPad Chrome (including touch interaction for the evasive "No" button).

requirements.text: Update or restore frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md so it contains complete, step-by-step production build and redeploy instructions (in English), including how to rerun deployment after a failure and how to validate the icp0.io subdomain using the existing validation script.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md contains clear, complete production build and redeploy steps.
Documentation includes a section explaining how to validate a subdomain using frontend/scripts/validate-icp0-subdomain.mjs.
Documentation includes a short troubleshooting section for common build/deploy failures and how to retry.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI components).
Do not modify any files listed under frontend.immutablePaths in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); add migration code only if persistent state changes are required.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new Valentine interactions or changing the existing copy/layout beyond what is required to fix deployment and documentation.
Introducing new backend services, external databases, or third-party authentication providers (Internet Identity only).
